title: nightly-skip now runs on every event, so every draft PR push starts one ubuntu runner; add a draft guard that fits the lint
why: Decision draft-until-reviewed says CI skips drafts, and PR #3292 lets one cheap job run on each draft push.
source: Lane all-jobs-passed-docs-only-red (session_013NEJL2mVxp6aijDQkbL7Rd), 16:58 CST Nov 13, on PR #3292 (head bbcec1566f); the round 1 reviewer's read of checks.yml; unchecked by triage.
note: Filed 16:59 CST Nov 13. PR #3292 fixes the red gate (step all-jobs-passed-docs-only-red) by running nightly-skip on every event. Cost: one cheap ubuntu runner per draft push, unmeasured. A job guard `!github.event.pull_request.draft` would avoid it, but the new lint demands no job-level `if` on that job. Fix: a draft guard that FITS the lint; do not relax the lint to fit this repo (owner ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo). Also test it against the skipped-ancestor bug that caused the red gate. Follow-up to #3292; waits for it to merge. Past rulings not checked. Not started.
